phases.action: Collect and classify all documents (invoices, receipts, POs). Extract structured data via OCR. Score confidence. Flag low-quality or unreadable documents.

Build ledger from extracted documents. Validate arithmetic and tax. Detect duplicates (S1). Match POs (S3). Identify overdue payments (S4). Categorize spending (S5). Raise exceptions for escalation (S6).
Convert exceptions to plain-language tasks. Draft chase emails for overdue items. Generate final report: cash in/out, category breakdown, top 3 actions.
